policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a provisional translation of an overview document. The act is primarily a promotion and framework law rather than a strict regulatory regime. Partial enforcement began 4 June 2025, full enforcement 1 September 2025. Binding obligations on business operators appear limited to cooperation duties. Detailed requirements will likely emerge via guidelines and the AI Basic Plan.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around economic competitiveness and innovation promotion, emphasizing that Japan is lagging behind in AI development and needs to enhance international competitiveness while aiming to be the friendliest country for AI development. National security and human rights are mentioned but are secondary to the economic and innovation rationale.
